Terms and Conditions of Use

Welcome to Daan Foundation's Website

Daan Foundation, an Indian trust based in India, is pleased to provide you with access to our website. By using this site, you agree to comply with and be bound by the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.

  1. Acceptance of Terms

Your use of this site constitutes your acceptance of these Terms and Conditions as of the date of your first use of the site.

  1. Changes to Terms

Daan Foundation reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time by posting changes online. Your continued use of this site after changes are posted constitutes your acceptance of the modified agreement.

  1. Lawful Use

You agree to use this site for lawful purposes, without infringing the rights of any third party.

  1. Disclaimer of Warranty

This site and information provided are "as is" without any representation or endorsement. Daan Foundation will not be liable for any damages arising from the use or loss of use of the site.

  1. Functionality and Accuracy

While we strive for correct and timely information, we do not warrant uninterrupted, error-free functions, or the absence of viruses. Your use is at your own risk.

  1. Concerns about Accuracy

If you find material factually inaccurate, please notify us at write2us@daanfoundation.in.

  1. Copyright and Use of Material

Copyright in information and materials belongs to Daan Foundation. Materials may be used for personal, educational, and not-for-profit purposes with proper attribution. Unauthorized sale or use for personal gain is strictly prohibited.

  1. Third-Party Material

Some materials are published with permission; rights are reserved by the copyright owners. Permission to copy must be requested from the respective owners.

  1. External Internet Sites

Daan Foundation is not responsible for the content of external sites linked on this website.

  1. Photographs

Inclusion of persons in images does not indicate their health status. To respect privacy, photographs and names may not necessarily represent the actual individuals.

  1. Website Linking

Organizations wishing to set up a link to this site must complete a link request form, agreeing to the attached Terms and Conditions.

  1. Public Communications

Any communication or material posted on the site is non-confidential and non-proprietary.

  1. Conflict Resolution

In case of conflicts between these Terms and Conditions and specific terms on the site, the latter shall prevail.

  1. Governing Law

These Terms and Conditions are governed by the laws of the Republic of India, and any disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the Delhi Courts.

  1. Termination

If these Terms and Conditions are not accepted in full, your use of this site must be ended immediately.

Thank you for visiting Daan Foundation's website. For inquiries, contact us at daanfoundationindia@gmail.com
